total_model.summary: Model projects 41.6 total points (MIA 21, NYJ 21). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 2.8), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.8), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (lowers total 1.4). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
